# Menu 222 (delete unused frames) on swing600.pmm. Three equal keys of 首
# (chain8) and of い (morph4) make the middle one redundant; the info box
# with the deleted count goes to messages.tsv.
load pmm swing600.pmm
select model chain8
select bone 首
frame 10
bone rotation 0 0 10
register bone
frame 20
bone rotation 0 0 10
register bone
frame 30
bone rotation 0 0 10
register bone
save pmm keys-chain8.pmm
delete unused
save pmm unused-chain8.pmm
select all bone
save vmd unused-chain8.vmd
select model morph4
select morph 2 い
frame 520
morph 2 0.5
register morph 2
frame 540
morph 2 0.5
register morph 2
frame 560
morph 2 0.5
register morph 2
save pmm keys-morph4.pmm
delete unused
save pmm unused-morph4.pmm
select all morph
save vmd unused-morph4.vmd
